text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] inference-prod — multiple nodes in infer-pool-usw2 reporting NotReady for ~5m, elevated 502s and tail latency for small % of requests. Paging on-call.

morgan: ack, I'm on it. pulling node statuses now.

morgan: ```kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep 'infer-pool-usw2'
ip-10-0-3-12   NotReady   10m   v1.23.8   <none>   1 gpu
ip-10-0-3-14   Ready      2h    v1.23.8   <none>   1 gpu
ip-10-0-3-15   NotReady   8m    v1.23.8   <none>   1 gpu
ip-10-0-3-18   NotReady   6m    v1.23.8   <none>   1 gpu```

lee: seeing kubelet restart loops on ip-10-0-3-12 and ip-10-0-3-15. GPU driver errors in syslog: 

lee: ```dmesg | tail -n 8
NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=4521, GPU might be lost, possible hang
NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
kernel: GPU reset failed with error -22
```

sam: are pods dying with OOM or driver crash? any customer-facing errors?

morgan: model-server pods on those nodes reported OOMKilled and restart loops. snippet from pod describe: 

morgan: ```kubectl describe pod model-server-ff9 -n inference
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age    From               Message
  ----     ------     ----   ----               -------
  Warning  OOMKilled  9m     kubelet, ip-10-0  Container "model-server" was killed because it ran out of memory
```

vic: looks like two related issues: kernel/GPU resets causing stale GPU state, then containers allocate and get OOM on retry. we should cordon+drain affected nodes and scale up temporarily.

morgan: doing cordon/drain now. 

morgan: ```kubectl cordon ip-10-0-3-12 && kubectl drain ip-10-0-3-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data -n inference```

infra-runner: I see a pattern — we rolled node-image with kernel 5.15 yesterday. kernel->nvidia-driver regression causing GPU hangs on some cards. starting ASG rollback to previous AMI for this ASG, will replace instances one by one.

lee: also seeing CUDA errors in runtime logs before the OOMKilled: 

lee: ```kubectl logs model-server-ff9 -n inference | tail -n 5
[2026-03-17T10:12:03Z] RuntimeError: Cuda error: an illegal memory access was encountered
[2026-03-17T10:12:03Z] Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
RuntimeError: cuCtxSynchronize() failed: CUDA error: out of memory
```

sam: support reported a customer seeing intermittent 502s ~10:11-10:18 UTC, small percentage but reproducible. support ticket INC-2026-1123 created and linked to this thread.

vic: mitigation plan: 1) cordon+drain affected nodes 2) scale up infer-pool autoscaler +2 capacity 3) roll back ASG AMI -> replace instances 4) restart kubelet on nodes after replacement 5) enable fallback routing to smaller model for heavy tenants while we stabilize.

morgan: enacted autoscaler bump: increasing target replicas +2 to create buffer. routing change: temporarily send large-model traffic to redwood-small-v1 for customers on tier-dev only.

infra-runner: ASG rollback started, 3/4 replacements in progress. scheduling kubelet restart window for the last node after replacement completes.

lee: I'm tailing dmesg and runtime logs, will post any new Xid errors.

morgan: observed one pod stabilized after drain/evac onto a healthy node; latency for that service returned to normal. metrics: p95 dropped from 320ms -> 110ms on that route.

vic: thanks. I'm going to take over monitoring for the next 2 hours. morgan, please hand off any remaining context.

morgan: handing off to vic: drained 2/4 nodes (ip-10-0-3-12, ip-10-0-3-15), autoscaler +2 applied, ASG rollback in flight (3/4 replaced), created INC-2026-1123, support notified, temporary model fallback enabled.

vic: taking it. will watch infra dashboard and model error logs. ping me if latency > 200ms or error rate > 0.5%.

infra-runner: ASG rollback complete for 3 instances, last replacement scheduled in 6m. kubelet restart queued post-replace.

morgan: removing pager for now — will wait for 15m stable window then close incident.

vic: confirmed metrics stable for 20m, error rate returned to baseline. marking incident mitigated, preparing short postmortem notes. tagging @postmortem for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

oncall-next: thanks team, I'll pick up the PM for the postmortem and follow through on AMI gating to prevent re-release without repro validation. :thumbsup:
